help: Where Bagel posts. Leave one unset and that post is skipped.
title: Channels
clipsHelp: Every clip from !clip and from Twitch itself.
liveHelp: One post when you go live, edited when you go offline.
logCategoriesHelp: Each switch needs staff logs on in Community ops.
logCategoryChannelHelp: Empty uses the staff logs channel.
logHelp: Joins, leaves, edits, deletes and moderation.
logIgnoreBotsHelp: Skip messages and joins from bots.
logIgnoredHelp: Nothing from these channels is logged. Up to {max}.
logVoiceHelp: Joins, leaves and moves in voice channels.
subsCategoryHelp: The category the subscriber channels live under.
subsHelp: The private text channel for your subscriber tier.
vipCategoryHelp: The category the VIP channels live under.
vipHelp: The private text channel for your VIPs.
voiceCategoryHelp: Rooms are created only in this category. Required once a hub is set.
voiceCategoryRequired: Pick a category: rooms are only created inside one.
voiceHubHelp: Joining this voice channel clones a personal room.
voiceNameHelp: Use {owner} for the member name. Empty uses the member name alone.
voicePrivacyHelp: Open, locked to new joiners, or hidden from the channel list.
welcomeHelp: One embed per new member. Bagel never DMs joiners.
